blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A trader's week is full. On Monday, the market opens. On Tuesday, there are client calls. On Wednesday, Ethan writes reports.

On Thursday, the team has meetings. On Friday, they wrap up the week and send the weekly reports. Ethan is usually at his desk by 8. He always checks the market on Monday.

The market is always closed on weekends. Ethan never works on Sundays. He sometimes travels to Brazil, but not often.

items.q: What happens on Monday?
items.why: "On Monday, the market opens."

items.q: When does the team send the weekly reports?
items.why: "On Friday, they wrap up the week and send the weekly reports."

items.q: How often does Ethan check the market on Monday?
items.why: "He always checks the market on Monday."

items.q: The text suggests that Ethan's weekend is…
options: the same as a work day
a time to rest, not to work
items.why: Inferência: o mercado fecha no fim de semana e Ethan nunca trabalha aos domingos, então é tempo de descanso.

items.q: Which sentence would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: Ethan travels to Brazil every week.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "sometimes" e "not often" — ele viaja às vezes, não toda semana.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan falar sobre a semana dele. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I am Ethan, and this is my week.

I always start early. From Monday to Friday, I am usually at my desk by 8. I love the morning. Clients often call before lunch, so I never leave my phone far away.

Monday is my busy day. The market opens and I check everything. On Tuesday, I have many calls. On Wednesday, I write reports. Thursday is for meetings with the team. And on Friday, we close deals and send the weekly report.

I sometimes travel to Brazil for work, but not every week. It is only a few times a year.

On the weekend, I rest. The market is always closed on Saturday and Sunday, so I never work then. I usually see my family and I sleep more. On Monday, I start again!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time is Ethan usually at his desk?
items.why: "I am usually at my desk by 8."

items.q: Which day is Ethan's busy day?
items.why: "Monday is my busy day."

items.q: What does Ethan do on the weekend?
options: He rests and sees his family.
items.why: "On the weekend, I rest… I usually see my family and I sleep more."

items.q: Why does Ethan keep his phone close?
options: Because clients often call before lunch
items.why: Inferência: os clientes ligam com frequência de manhã, então ele mantém o telefone por perto.

items.q: How does Ethan feel about his mornings?
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "I love the morning" e começa cedo — ele gosta das manhãs.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have a big meeting on Monday." Monday is…
items.why: Monday = segunda-feira, o primeiro dia útil da semana.

items.q: "The team sends a weekly report." Weekly means…
items.why: Weekly = semanal, uma vez por semana.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ check the market on Monday. I never miss it."
items.why: Always = sempre; combina com "I never miss it".

items.q: "We do not work on the weekend." The weekend is…
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana (sábado e domingo).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We close deals every ___, at the end of the week."
items.why: Friday = sexta-feira, o fim da semana de trabalho.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "On Friday, we wrap up the week." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = finalizar, fechar o que estava aberto.

items.q: "Clients call in the morning." To call in means to…
items.why: Call in = telefonar, entrar em contato por telefone.

items.q: "We close a deal on Friday." To close a deal means to…
items.why: Close a deal = fechar um negócio, concluir um acordo.

items.q: "I start early on Monday." To start early means to…
items.why: Start early = começar cedo, antes do horário comum.

items.q: "I am usually at my desk by 8." To be at your desk means to…
items.why: At your desk = na sua mesa, pronto para trabalhar.
